Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE game action sprite sheet for OPS ImAn, a Malaysian Year 2 educational game. The THREE supplied images are identity and 3D style REFERENCES: image1 Najmi boy, image2 Putri ponytail girl, image3 Nabilah hijab girl. Keep these exact navy/royal blue/gold fictional uniforms, friendly faces, star shield badge, polished dimensional chibi shading.
Make a landscape sheet with exactly 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, preferably 1536x1024. The first FIVE cells contain the five scenes below in reading order. The sixth bottom-right cell MUST be completely empty and transparent.
Each cell is independently usable as one focused illustration. Keep the complete character(s) and essential action props inside the central 80% of their cell, with generous fully transparent gaps around all four sides; no overlaps between cells. GENUINE alpha transparency. No grid lines, labels, words, letters, numbers, captions, decorative buildings, unrelated props, panels or background boxes. Ground contact shadow only. Safe, warm, friendly. NO guns, handcuffs, batons, real police logos, violence or injury. Full body, clear hands and clear action-to-object contact. Distinguish the five actions exactly.
Cell 1 (top row): Najmi, the boy, standing and LOOKING carefully at an unfolded street MAP held in both hands, eyes down at the visible route.
Cell 2 (top row): Putri, the ponytail girl, READING an open GUIDEBOOK, book clearly has pages and is not a map.
Cell 3 (top row): Nabilah, the hijab girl, LISTENING attentively to an incoming message on a handheld communication RADIO held at her EAR. Her mouth closed, listening pose, free hand cupped near ear.
Cell 4 (bottom row): Najmi SWEEPING the police station courtyard with a broom, a small sweep of dry leaves on the ground. No building.
Cell 5 (bottom row): Putri PAINTING a small blue picket FENCE with a brush and open paint pot. Brush visibly touches a partially painted fence.
